category: Off-by-one error in a loop or array/slice boundary
description: Off-by-one loop condition (i > 1 instead of i >= 1) omits rotating .1 to .2, causing the first backup log to be overwritten.

category: Incorrect comparison operator (e.g. = instead of ==, or a flipped condition)
description: Flipped comparison operator (!== instead of ===) in verifyOtp causes verification to succeed for invalid OTPs and fail for valid ones.

category: Missing await on an async call (a real bug pattern in this async/TypeScript codebase)
description: Missing await on notifyService.update() causes an unresolved Promise object rather than the updated notification record to be returned in the response.
